auth.welcome: Your invoices, services and pricing history stay private to your account.
auth.resetMessage: We'll email you a secure link to choose a new password.
auth.heroTitle: Invoices worthy of the service you provide.
auth.heroDescription: Historic pricing, immutable invoice numbers and A4-ready PDFs, all private to your account, all in pounds sterling.
auth.heroIsolation: Owner-only data isolation on every record.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Every invoice you have generated, newest first. Records are immutable once issued.
dashboard.generateNewDesc: Prefilled with today's date and current service pricing
dashboard.noReceiptsSearchDesc: Try a different invoice number, customer name or service.
dashboard.noReceiptsDesc: Generate your first invoice to start building your library.

receipt.receiptNotYours: This invoice does not exist or is not yours.
receipt.notesPlaceholder: Any additional notes to clarify expenses or the service provided.
receipt.lockedWarning: The invoice number and totals are locked once generated.
receipt.newReceiptDesc: Pricing is resolved from the service's price history for the invoice date. Anything you change here is snapshotted onto this invoice only.

services.title: Services
services.description: Each service keeps a full price history. Editing a price closes the previous period and opens a new one, past invoices never change.
services.addNewServiceDesc: The price you set starts a new effective period from the date chosen.
services.editServiceDesc: Details apply to future invoices only. Use “Change price” to adjust pricing.
services.changePriceDesc: A new price period starts on the chosen date. Existing invoices are never altered. A future date schedules the price in advance.

managers.title: Managers
managers.description: Add new users to the platform. They will be able to sign in and upload their invoices using the shared samples.
managers.addManagerDescription: Create a new account. The new manager will automatically have sample services generated for them when their account is created.
managers.secureIsolationDescription: Each manager's data is isolated. They can only see invoices and services that they create. Sample services are automatically provisioned upon account creation.
managers.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? This will delete the manager.
managers.deleteWarning: This will permanently remove their access.
managers.leaveBlank: Leave blank to keep the current password.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your business profile and preferences.
settings.languageDescription: Choose your preferred language for the interface.
settings.businessNameDesc: Shown in the app header and printed on new invoices.
settings.businessLogoDesc: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG · up to 2 MB. Stored privately and served through short-lived signed links.
settings.pushNotificationsDesc: Get notified when managers create new invoices.
settings.notSupported: Push notifications are not supported in this browser
settings.blocked: You have blocked notifications in your browser settings.

workers.title: Workers
workers.description: Manage workers who provide services. Workers are assigned numbers for privacy on payout documents.
workers.addWorkerDescription: Create a new worker profile. A unique worker number will be automatically assigned.
workers.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? This will delete the worker.
workers.deleteWarning: This will permanently remove the worker.
workers.noPayoutsFound: No payouts found for this worker.
workers.activeStatusDesc: Inactive workers won't appear in the payout dropdown.
workers.deleteWorkerDesc: This action is permanent and will hide all associated payouts from the system. You will no longer be able to view or manage this worker's history.
workers.deleteConfirmDesc: You are about to delete this worker. This action cannot be undone.
workers.deleteDoubleConfirmDesc: Are you absolutely sure? This will remove all of their payout history from your views.

payout.payoutNotYours: This payout does not exist or is not yours.
payout.notesPlaceholder: Any additional notes to clarify expenses or the service provided.
payout.lockedWarning: The payout number and totals are locked once generated.
payout.newPayoutDesc: Pricing is resolved from the service's price history for the payout date. Anything you change here is snapshotted onto this payout only.

payoutsDashboard.title: Payouts
payoutsDashboard.description: Every payout you have generated, newest first. Records are immutable once issued.
payoutsDashboard.generateNewDesc: Prefilled with today's date and current service pricing
payoutsDashboard.noPayoutsSearchDesc: Try a different payout number, worker or service.
payoutsDashboard.noPayoutsDesc: Generate your first payout to start building your library.
